description: The decompiled code here is only bad instruction data and truncates control flow at a halt. It is not a working routine.

name: set_display_control_registers
description: Writes a value derived from its argument into the first display scroll register, sets fixed values into the playfield priority register, calls one routine, and then writes a final DMA control value. The display and DMA control registers are the hardware registers it touches.

name: write_six_address_word_pairs
description: Stores an address and a fixed constant in the structure, computes a control value from the argument by a rotation and offset, then writes six 32-bit addresses as high and low word pairs, stepping each by a fixed amount.

name: copy_and_clear_palette_tables
description: Copies 32 words from a table into a second area while zeroing the originals, then copies 256 words from two further tables into two areas, zeroing the sources, and sets a state value to 30.

name: clear_shared_word_block
description: Zeroes 544 words starting at a fixed address and sets a state value to 30.

name: fill_word_tables_from_routine
description: Fills 32 words and then 256 pairs of words in two areas, each with a value returned by a routine, and sets a state value to 30.

name: compute_nibble_sum_mask
description: Adds the three nibbles of the argument, adds a state offset, caps the total at 47 and divides by three. The result is multiplied by 273 to repeat a nibble across a word and combined with a second argument.

name: fill_table_entries_by_mode
description: Fills either 256 table entries in two interleaved areas or 32 and 256 entries from routine results, depending on bit 0 of a state value, then decrements the state.

name: return_void_no_effect
description: Returns immediately with no work.

name: process_four_table_bytes
description: Walks four bytes of the state table starting at the index given in the argument, and for each nonzero byte calls a routine with its value. It returns the result of the last call.

name: scan_table_for_nonzero_entry
description: Scans up to four records 148 bytes apart from a fixed table for a nonzero first longword. It returns its input value unchanged in every case, so it has no visible effect on that value.

name: advance_four_timers_on_wrap
description: When the state is nonzero, increments four counters and, when the first passes 63, sets a flag bit, resets all four counters and clears the state.

name: decode_packed_bit_flags
description: When the state is zero, reads a packed control byte through a pointer. It either sets a state value to minus one when the top bit is set, or sets five state values to all ones or zero from the low bits, advancing the pointer as it goes.

name: initialise_packed_byte_stream
description: Writes 255 to the address held in an address register, moves the pointer on to the next byte, clears a counter and clears the state.

name: write_cia_a_word_registers
description: Writes the low and high bytes of the argument to a pair of CIA-A registers, sets a state value to one and keeps the upper bits of the state.

name: write_cia_b_word_registers
description: Like its neighbour, writes the low and high bytes of the argument to a pair of CIA-B registers, and sets a control value with a fixed bit.

name: write_stepped_values_loop
description: Reads a count and a start value from a structure, then calls a routine with each value in turn, stepping the value by two and incrementing a state counter on each step.

name: draw_sprite_plane_blits
description: Waits for the blitter-busy bit to clear, records a value into a per-object table, derives edge flags from two position fields and writes pointer words into the sprite area. When the first value is nonzero it programs blits for four planes with a row offset; several branches are partly garbled, so the exact geometry is not established.

name: update_display_label_text
description: When the state differs from the value stored in a record, copies a short block of characters into it and updates the record through routine calls. It then clamps an index to a maximum of three and writes it, and when the state is zero it clamps a second index to four and writes table-derived values.

name: interleave_plane_bytes
description: Copies ten groups of four bytes from a source into a destination, writing each group's bytes to two positions 436 bytes apart so that the data ends up in interleaved positions.

name: wait_blitter_and_set_pointers
description: Waits for the blitter-busy bit to clear four times, then writes two pointer values and the blitter size value.

name: wait_for_state_clear_sequence
description: Recovery of this 158-instruction routine is incomplete; the visible part clears a state value and waits on it. It calls 18 other routines and touches the first colour register and the DMA control register.

name: step_colour_state_machine
description: Steps a small state value through a fixed sequence of branches, calling routines at each step and wrapping the value to zero at the end. The first colour register is among the hardware registers it touches.

name: initialise_game_state_defaults
description: Zeroes 3416 words from a fixed address, calls one routine, and writes a series of default constants into the state, including a fixed 32-bit value.

name: clear_status_fields_to_ones
description: Sets four byte-sized state values to all ones and six longword fields to all ones at fixed addresses.

name: setup_blit_with_wait
description: Calls three routines, then waits for the blitter-busy bit to clear and writes fixed blitter mask, control and modulo values and two address values before waiting again.

name: clear_state_fields_after_calls
description: Calls two routines and then branches on a state value, clearing several state fields on the main path before returning. Parts of the branch structure are not fully recovered.

name: clear_twenty_state_values
description: Sets twenty state values to zero and returns.

name: set_triplet_state_if_active
description: Clears four state values and then, for each of three conditions tied to the state value, writes a fixed set of three values when that condition holds.

name: run_state_machine_step
description: Advances a multi-branch state machine: it checks an active flag, runs a sequence of counter and setup calls, and returns the value it captured at the start. The decompiled branches are partly garbled, so only the overall structure is recovered.

name: step_and_clamp_motion_value
description: Adds a fixed step to a state value and clamps it between limits that depend on its sign and a flag, calling a routine in the large-value branch. Several operands are partly garbled in the decompiled output, so the exact limits are not established.

name: step_and_clamp_alternate_range
description: Advances a state value by a two-step increment and clamps it at limits such as 150 and 50 in its branches, calling a routine on the large-value path. The decompiled branch structure is partly garbled.

name: update_offset_with_clamp_four
description: Adds four to a state value, subtracts an offset chosen from a small set of constants, and clamps the result, returning early for certain states. The decompiled operands are partly garbled.

name: update_offset_with_clamp_eight
description: Adds eight to a state value, subtracts an offset chosen from a small set of constants, and clamps the result, returning early for certain states. The decompiled operands are partly garbled.

name: reset_or_clamp_state_value
description: Sets the state to zero or to fixed limit values depending on its sign and a flag, and nudges small values by one before returning.

name: add_offset_and_clamp_high
description: Adds a fixed offset of 40960 to a state value, clamps its high word to a maximum of 15, and resets the state for certain values before returning.

name: select_state_from_mask_bits
description: Tests bits of a state value and calls routines for matching masks, then sets a state value to 96 when a related state is zero.

name: clamp_delta_to_eight
description: Computes the difference between two state values and applies it as a step when its magnitude is at most eight. Otherwise it clears the state.

name: update_motion_with_range_checks
description: Performs a range-checked update of a state value, clamping an adjusted value to plus or minus fifteen and calling routines for certain bit patterns, then sets flags and resets state fields. The decompiled operands are partly garbled.

name: clamp_scaled_value_to_three
description: Adds a fixed offset of 5462 to a state value, clamps the high word to at most three and, when negative, to at least minus fifteen. It doubles the result and calls routines on the non-negative path.

name: clamp_scaled_value_to_two
description: Adds a fixed offset of 3280 to a state value, clamps the high word to at most two and, when negative, to at least minus fifteen. It doubles the result and calls routines on the non-negative path.

name: call_sequence_and_reset_flag
description: Calls six routines in sequence, copies a state value to itself, and clears the state when it is non-negative and a second flag is nonzero.

name: approach_target_with_clamped_step
description: Adjusts a state value toward a target by a clamped step, with a halving rule for larger differences. The decompiled output contains an endless loop on one negative-difference path.

name: store_pair_after_call
description: Calls one routine and then copies two values from the data registers into two state values.

name: restore_state_pair_after_call
description: Calls one routine and then copies two values from the data registers into two state values, as its neighbour does.

name: subtract_step_and_set_one
description: Subtracts a step from a state value, applies a correction when the result is negative and within a small magnitude range, then sets the state to one.

name: add_step_and_set_two
description: Adds a step to a state value, applying a correction when the result is non-negative and above the step, then sets the state to two.

name: subtract_step_clamped_four
description: Subtracts a step from a state value, adds the step back when the result is negative and not far below zero, and sets the state to four.

name: add_step_clamped_eight
description: Adds a step to a state value, subtracts it again when the result is positive and not too large, and sets the state to eight.

name: apply_fixed_point_step
description: Applies a fixed-point step to a state value, clamped at fifteen, with a direction bit deciding the sign, and calls two routines on the non-negative path. The decompiled output is partly garbled.
